brief:
An Israeli drone strike hit a café inside Gaza Port, located west of Gaza City, on Tuesday evening, killing six Palestinians and wounding several others, IMEMC News reported. The attack struck a civilian gathering space in the crowded port district.

The strike marked another reported breach of the ceasefire agreement between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups. The incident came as violations of the truce continued across Gaza, where months of fighting have left much of the territory in ruins, with widespread destruction of homes, hospitals, and other civilian infrastructure throughout the densely populated enclave.
